intro.fallback: ;Part 1 Because Zansūru seems to have been aware of Sakura's involvement, something only Jiji would know, Sasuke guesses that the two are working together.
When Sasuke returns to the Astronomy Research Institute, he quickly saves a group of prisoners from a revived dragon and instructs Menō to protect them while they escape.
As Menō departs with the prisoners, Sasuke sees the last of the Institute's buildings collapsing.

outro.fallback: Menō is indeed able to overpower the larger dragon, frustrating Zansūru.
